# Per-push fan-out of the pull-request CI path.
#
# Every workflow that triggers on `pull_request` is queued again by every
# push to a branch that heads an open pull request, and the runner pool
# those jobs share is finite. The totals below are a budget, not a report:
# they may fall, and they may only rise in the same change that
# re-measures them. A job whose matrix is not literal text is counted once
# and listed in `opaque`, so hiding a matrix behind an expression is a
# finding rather than free capacity. A job that calls a reusable workflow
# carries the callee's own jobs and runners, because GitHub queues the
# callee's work under the same push; a call into another repository cannot
# be read here, so it is counted once and listed in `opaque` too. A callee
# that is missing, or that calls back into its caller, is a finding.
#
# Re-measure in the same change that moves it:
#   cargo run --release --manifest-path xtask/gates/Cargo.toml -- ci-pull-request-fanout-is-budgeted --print-baseline
workflows: 25
jobs: 91
fanout: 101
opaque: 0
